General Terms and Conditions

For orders in the online shop · As of July 2026

1. Scope

These General Terms and Conditions (GTC) apply to all orders placed through the foedus paraj online shop. By placing an order, the customer agrees to these GTC.

2. Contracting party

The purchase contract is concluded with: Paraj Foedus Kkult, owner Gerrit Ruben Paraipan, Stationsstrasse 62, 3204 Bern, Switzerland. Contact: contact@foedusparaj.com

3. Conclusion of contract

The presentation of products in the online shop does not constitute a legally binding offer. By submitting an order, the customer makes a binding offer. The contract is concluded upon the order confirmation sent by email.

4. Prices

All prices are in Swiss francs (CHF) or euros (EUR), including statutory VAT where applicable. Shipping costs are shown separately during checkout.

5. Payment

Payment is made using the payment methods offered during checkout (e.g. credit/debit card, TWINT, PayPal). Payment is charged when the order is completed.

6. Delivery

Items are made in Switzerland. Delivery usually takes 3–4 weeks (made to order). Any delays will be communicated by email. The seller bears the risk of delivery until the goods are handed over to the customer.

7. Withdrawal & returns

Switzerland: There is no right of return with a refund of the purchase price. If the size does not fit, a one-time exchange for another size is possible within 14 days of receipt, provided the item is unworn and in its original condition; the customer bears the return shipping costs. In the event of defects, the item will be repaired or replaced and the seller bears the shipping costs. If neither is possible, the purchase price will be refunded.


European Union: Consumers resident in the European Union have the statutory right of withdrawal in accordance with the following withdrawal policy.


Right of withdrawal

You have the right to withdraw from this contract within fourteen days without giving any reason. The withdrawal period is fourteen days from the day on which you, or a third party other than the carrier designated by you, take possession of the goods.


To exercise your right of withdrawal, you must inform us (PARAJ FOEDUS KKULT INH. PARAIPAN, Stationsstrasse 62, 3204 Rosshäusern, Switzerland, contact@foedusparaj.com) of your decision to withdraw from this contract by means of a clear statement (e.g. a letter or email). You may use the attached model withdrawal form, but this is not mandatory. Alternatively, you can declare your withdrawal electronically using the “Withdraw from contract” function in the footer of every page.


To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient to send your notice before the withdrawal period expires.


Effects of withdrawal

If you withdraw from this contract, we shall reimburse all payments received from you, including the costs of delivery (with the exception of additional costs resulting from your choice of a type of delivery other than the least expensive standard delivery offered by us), without undue delay and in any event no later than fourteen days from the day on which we are informed of your decision to withdraw from this contract. We will use the same means of payment that you used for the original transaction; in no event will you be charged any fees for this reimbursement. We may withhold reimbursement until we have received the goods back or until you have supplied evidence of having sent back the goods.


You shall send back the goods without undue delay and in any event no later than fourteen days from the day on which you inform us of your withdrawal. You bear the direct cost of returning the goods. You are only liable for any diminished value of the goods resulting from handling other than what is necessary to establish their nature, characteristics and functioning.
